source.title: Christian Astrology
source.author: William Lilly
source.transcription: archive.org identifier bim_early-english-books-1641-1700_christian-astrology-_lilly-william_1647 ("Early English Books, 1641-1700" collection) — a mechanical OCR of a 1647 photographic facsimile, public domain
source.note: Excerpts are lightly normalized (long s, obvious OCR noise) but otherwise Lilly's own wording, drawn from Book I's per-planet "nature and signification" chapters (pp. 57-83 of the original). Lilly contrasts only two states per planet — well dignified vs. ill/afflicted — not four, so the well-dignified excerpt is reused for both `ruler` and `exalted`, and the ill excerpt for both `detriment` and `fall`. That's classical practice, not an invented distinction: rulership and exaltation are both positive essential dignity, detriment and fall are both its absence, and Lilly's descriptive prose never splits finer than that.

excerpts.dignity-state:saturn:ruler: Profound in imagination; in his acts severe; in speaking and giving, very sparing; in labour patient; in arguing or disputing, grave; studious and solicitous to obtain the good things of this life; in all manner of actions, austere.
excerpts.dignity-state:saturn:exalted: Profound in imagination; in his acts severe; in speaking and giving, very sparing; in labour patient; in arguing or disputing, grave; studious and solicitous to obtain the good things of this life; in all manner of actions, austere.
excerpts.dignity-state:saturn:detriment: Envious, covetous, jealous, and mistrustful; morose, sordid, outwardly dissembling, sluggish, suspicious, stubborn; a contemner of women; a close liar, malicious, murmuring, never contented, ever repining.
excerpts.dignity-state:saturn:fall: Envious, covetous, jealous, and mistrustful; morose, sordid, outwardly dissembling, sluggish, suspicious, stubborn; a contemner of women; a close liar, malicious, murmuring, never contented, ever repining.
excerpts.dignity-state:jupiter:ruler: Magnanimous, faithful, bashful, aspiring in an honourable way at high matters; in all his actions a lover of fair dealing, desiring to benefit all men, doing glorious things, honourable and religious, of sweet and affable conversation; reverencing aged men, a great reliever of the poor, full of charity and godliness; liberal, hating all sordid actions; just, wise, thankful, virtuous.
excerpts.dignity-state:jupiter:exalted: Magnanimous, faithful, bashful, aspiring in an honourable way at high matters; in all his actions a lover of fair dealing, desiring to benefit all men, doing glorious things, honourable and religious, of sweet and affable conversation; reverencing aged men, a great reliever of the poor, full of charity and godliness; liberal, hating all sordid actions; just, wise, thankful, virtuous.
excerpts.dignity-state:jupiter:detriment: Wastes his patrimony, suffers every one to cozen him, is hypocritically religious, tenacious and stiff in maintaining false tenets in religion; ignorant, careless, of a gross, dull capacity, schismatical, abasing himself in all companies, crouching and stooping where no necessity is.
excerpts.dignity-state:jupiter:fall: Wastes his patrimony, suffers every one to cozen him, is hypocritically religious, tenacious and stiff in maintaining false tenets in religion; ignorant, careless, of a gross, dull capacity, schismatical, abasing himself in all companies, crouching and stooping where no necessity is.
excerpts.dignity-state:mars:ruler: In feats of war and courage, invincible; scorning any that should exceed him; bold, confident, immovable, contentious, challenging all honour to themselves; valiant, lovers of war and things pertaining thereunto, hazarding himself to all perils; a large reporter of his own acts; yet of prudent behaviour in his own affairs.
excerpts.dignity-state:mars:exalted: In feats of war and courage, invincible; scorning any that should exceed him; bold, confident, immovable, contentious, challenging all honour to themselves; valiant, lovers of war and things pertaining thereunto, hazarding himself to all perils; a large reporter of his own acts; yet of prudent behaviour in his own affairs.
excerpts.dignity-state:mars:detriment: A prattler without modesty or honesty; a lover of slaughter and quarrels, murder, thievery; a promoter of sedition, frays and commotions; a highway-thief, as wavering as the wind, a traitor, of turbulent spirit, perjured, obscene, rash, inhumane; neither fearing God nor caring for man; unthankful, furious, violent.
excerpts.dignity-state:mars:fall: A prattler without modesty or honesty; a lover of slaughter and quarrels, murder, thievery; a promoter of sedition, frays and commotions; a highway-thief, as wavering as the wind, a traitor, of turbulent spirit, perjured, obscene, rash, inhumane; neither fearing God nor caring for man; unthankful, furious, violent.
excerpts.dignity-state:sun:ruler: Very faithful, keeping their promises with all punctuality; prudent, and of incomparable judgment; of great majesty and stateliness, industrious to acquire honour and a large patrimony, yet as willingly departing therewith again; full of thought, secret, trusty, speaks deliberately; affable, tractable, and very humane to all people, loving sumptuousness and magnificence, and whatever is honourable; no sordid thoughts can enter his heart.
excerpts.dignity-state:sun:exalted: Very faithful, keeping their promises with all punctuality; prudent, and of incomparable judgment; of great majesty and stateliness, industrious to acquire honour and a large patrimony, yet as willingly departing therewith again; full of thought, secret, trusty, speaks deliberately; affable, tractable, and very humane to all people, loving sumptuousness and magnificence, and whatever is honourable; no sordid thoughts can enter his heart.
excerpts.dignity-state:sun:detriment: Arrogant and proud, disdaining all men, cracking of his pedigree; purblind in sight and judgment, restless, troublesome, domineering, a mere vapour, expensive, foolish, endued with no gravity in words nor soberness in actions; a spendthrift, wasting his patrimony, and hanging after on other men's charity, yet thinks all men are bound to him.
excerpts.dignity-state:sun:fall: Arrogant and proud, disdaining all men, cracking of his pedigree; purblind in sight and judgment, restless, troublesome, domineering, a mere vapour, expensive, foolish, endued with no gravity in words nor soberness in actions; a spendthrift, wasting his patrimony, and hanging after on other men's charity, yet thinks all men are bound to him.
excerpts.dignity-state:venus:ruler: A quiet man, not given to law, quarrel or wrangling; not vicious, pleasant, neat and spruce, loving mirth in his words and actions, cleanly in apparel; musical, delighting in baths and all honest merry meetings; easy of belief, cheerful, nothing mistrustful; a right virtuous man or woman, oft had in some jealousy, yet no cause for it.
excerpts.dignity-state:venus:exalted: A quiet man, not given to law, quarrel or wrangling; not vicious, pleasant, neat and spruce, loving mirth in his words and actions, cleanly in apparel; musical, delighting in baths and all honest merry meetings; easy of belief, cheerful, nothing mistrustful; a right virtuous man or woman, oft had in some jealousy, yet no cause for it.
excerpts.dignity-state:venus:detriment: Riotous, expensive, wholly given to looseness and lewd companies; nothing regarding his reputation, defiling beds, incestuous, an adulterer, fantastical, of no faith, no repute, no credit; spending his means in ale-houses and taverns amongst scandalous, loose people; a mere lazy companion, nothing careful of the things of this life, or anything religious; a mere atheist.
excerpts.dignity-state:venus:fall: Riotous, expensive, wholly given to looseness and lewd companies; nothing regarding his reputation, defiling beds, incestuous, an adulterer, fantastical, of no faith, no repute, no credit; spending his means in ale-houses and taverns amongst scandalous, loose people; a mere lazy companion, nothing careful of the things of this life, or anything religious; a mere atheist.
excerpts.dignity-state:mercury:ruler: A man of a subtle and politic brain, an excellent disputant or logician, arguing with judgment and discretion, using much eloquence in his speech; a searcher into all kinds of mysteries and learning, sharp and witty, learning almost anything without a teacher; ambitious of exquisite skill in every science, desirous naturally of travel and seeing foreign parts.
excerpts.dignity-state:mercury:exalted: A man of a subtle and politic brain, an excellent disputant or logician, arguing with judgment and discretion, using much eloquence in his speech; a searcher into all kinds of mysteries and learning, sharp and witty, learning almost anything without a teacher; ambitious of exquisite skill in every science, desirous naturally of travel and seeing foreign parts.
excerpts.dignity-state:mercury:detriment: Easy of belief, an ass or very idiot, constant in no place or opinion, eating and thieving everywhere; a news-monger, pretending all manner of knowledge, but guilty of no true or solid learning; a trifler, a mere frantic fellow; frothy, of no judgment, easily perverted, constant in nothing but idle words and bragging.
excerpts.dignity-state:mercury:fall: Easy of belief, an ass or very idiot, constant in no place or opinion, eating and thieving everywhere; a news-monger, pretending all manner of knowledge, but guilty of no true or solid learning; a trifler, a mere frantic fellow; frothy, of no judgment, easily perverted, constant in nothing but idle words and bragging.
excerpts.dignity-state:moon:ruler: One of composed manners, a soft, tender creature, a lover of all honest and ingenuous sciences; a searcher of, and delighter in, novelties; timorous, prodigal, and easily frighted; however loving peace, and to live free from the cares of this life.

excerpts.dignity-state:moon:detriment: A mere vagabond, idle person, hating labour, a drunkard, a sot; one of no spirit or forecast, delighting to live beggarly and carelessly; one content in no condition of life, either good or ill.
